instruction: From the current working directory, recursively find every regular file whose name matches the shell glob “*failed.ipynb” (i.e., any basename that ends with “failed.ipynb”), and copy them into the “./fails” directory located in this same current directory, creating it if it doesn’t exist. Preserve each file’s path relative to the current directory under “./fails” (mirror the subdirectory structure; don’t flatten). Leave the originals in place (copy, don’t move), and it’s fine to overwrite any existing copies in “./fails”. Only include files that match the pattern; ignore everything else.
